items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: Somebody called Shelley Mann a saxophone player.

ctx.x: Okay, we had it all for a second there. Go ahead, Rudy, about going to Italy.

Well, what I wanted to say, or I think would interest you, is that naturally I've been buying a lot of Italian magazines. I've been keeping up with the news in Italy. And I know there is a tremendous trend toward Dixieland music in Italy. They like it. They really love it. In fact, they have a lot of groups coming up. They may not sound like the original Dixieland that we have in America, but at least they're trying. And, boy, I give them credit. Because they like it and they're trying very hard to do it. And I…
